functionalRequirement: The system shall generate reports on storage consumption by financial contact.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must generate comprehensive storage consumption reports that include 100% of relevant financial contact data points.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures the report generation covers all necessary information for complete storage analysis.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: Reports must be generated within 5 seconds for financial contacts with up to 10,000 storage entries.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides a reasonable response time for generating storage consumption reports.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Assistance: Reports must include clear legends, color-coded visualizations, and tooltips explaining storage consumption metrics.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Enhances user understanding of complex storage consumption data.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Recoverability: The system must maintain a 99.9% data accuracy rate in storage consumption reporting, with automatic error logging and recovery mechanisms.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures reliable and trustworthy reporting of storage consumption data.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: All financial contact storage reports must be encrypted at rest and in transit using AES-256 encryption.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Protects sensitive financial contact information during report generation and storage.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Analysability: Reports must be generated in standardized formats (PDF, CSV) with consistent structure for easy analysis and integration.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Facilitates further data analysis and system interoperability.

functionalRequirement: The system shall be able to generate a series of multiple-choice fraction questions that form a cohesive storyline to introduce a specific topic.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must generate mathematically accurate fraction questions with 100% computational precision.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures the educational content is mathematically sound and error-free.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: Question series generation must complete within 2 seconds for a set of 10 multiple-choice fraction questions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides quick question generation to maintain user engagement.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Learnability: Questions must progressively increase in difficulty and maintain a clear, coherent narrative structure.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Supports effective learning progression and maintains student interest.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: The system must provide immediate, constructive feedback for incorrect answers, explaining the correct solution.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Enhances learning experience by guiding students through their mistakes.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Faultlessness: The question generation algorithm must maintain a 99.5% reliability rate in creating logically connected and mathematically correct question series.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures consistent and high-quality educational content generation.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Adaptability: The system must support dynamic topic selection and difficulty level adjustment for question series generation.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Allows customization of educational content for different learning needs.
